messages.author: 5e551ab78c41d21e
messages.subject: Starting with GGIR
parts:
Hello Vincent,

Thank you for the great work you have invested in the GGIR package.

I use R a regular basis but just starting with GENEActiv sleep files. The files are collecting data over 15 days and are quite large.

When I type a very simple command to inspect the file I get the following message:

library(GGIR)


> dataf <- "C:/projects/diachron/data/6110001_032083_2016-08-05 09-30-05.bin"
> insp <- g.inspectfile(dataf)
Warning messages:
1: In readLines(binfile, 300) : line 27 appears to contain an embedded nul
2: In readLines(binfile, 300) : line 28 appears to contain an embedded nul
3: In readLines(binfile, 300) : line 29 appears to contain an embedded nul
4: In readLines(binfile, 300) : line 30 appears to contain an embedded nul
5: In readLines(binfile, 300) : line 39 appears to contain an embedded nul
6: In readLines(binfile, 300) : line 45 appears to contain an embedded nul
7: In scan(fc, skip = sk, what = "", n = 2, sep = ":", quiet = TRUE) :
  embedded nul(s) found in input

It looks like I have some kind of encoding issue since these lines correspond to the presence signs "caret at" in the bin file as seen in the VI editor.


any idea ?

Thanks in advance, best regards

Jean-Marc Theler

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Starting with GGIR
parts:
Hello Jean-Marc,
This warning seems to be related to R package GENEAread. GGIR uses
package GENEAread to read the binary accelerometer data.
To be honest I usually ignore this warning as the data is loaded and
it looks normal, but you are right that it would be good if someone
could investigate this.
Thanks
Vincent
